analysis_name: Wall v1 exploratory decision audit analysis

production_manifest.complete_case_definition: all six model/menu records are verified final result files

outcomes.P_minus_uniform_native_utility: P selected native utility - mean native utility over the 300-candidate menu
outcomes.P_minus_uniform_binary_success: success[P] - mean success over the 300-candidate menu
outcomes.normalized_gap: signed_native_menu_gap / (max(native_terminal_distance) - min(native_terminal_distance)); undefined for constant menus

primary_mask_and_support.case_aggregation: mean over three menu seeds and two models

uncertainty.sign_flip: exact for n<=20; otherwise 100000 Monte Carlo sign flips with seed 20260912 and +1 correction

frozen_predictors.thresholds: apply per-model Push-T-derived threshold without Wall retuning
frozen_predictors.logistic: apply frozen Push-T full-fit coefficients once; no Wall refit

diagnostics: P raw margin after distinct physical-action deduplication
raw AUROC for near-tie score and -raw-margin baseline
interpretation_guards: All results are descriptive or exploratory and do not establish physical risk.
Partial or in-progress files are not evidence.
The frozen threshold and logistic model are not retuned on Wall outcomes.
A complete production run is required before the CLI writes analysis output.
